records.name: Dispersion-normalized cross-sectional equity forecast (location-to-spread)
records.rejection_reason: Rejected after the preregistered 2004-2026 costed replay: gross and net mean returns were -21.04 and -33.13 bps per leg, the recent-era mean was -50.86 bps, zero of six neighboring specifications were positive, bootstrap P(mean <= 0) was 0.9855, and incremental portfolio Sharpe was -0.0785. Dispersion normalization underperformed the raw-location control by 41.19 bps per leg.
